_comment: Single source of truth for the unit spellings that make up the evaluated regression target. Loaded by both split_components.py (step 2) and normalise_units.py (step 3) so the two cannot drift. Keys are unit_key() output: NFKC folded, dashes unified, whitespace collapsed, case preserved. Values convert to micromolar.
excluded_substrate_variants: gfPET, pcPET, hcPET, 3PET, PET-02mer and the rest are PET in some form but heterogeneous in morphology and oligomer length. Including them adds 129 human-curated labels, all of which fall in train, so they cannot improve evaluation. Left out of the target and available as training-only augmentation.
